plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Self-serve pay-as-you-go account, no platform fee; GPU quota may need a request.

caveats: No universal list rate: GPU, CPU/RAM share, bandwidth and storage are host-offer-specific. Per-second compute; storage continues while stopped. Serverless uses underlying marketplace workers with no extra surcharge. Reserved prepayment up to 50% off is not a fixed tariff. Dated public API snapshots added for 1 GPU, verified hosts, reliability>=0.98; first two cheapest offers by total listed hourly price. dph_base is compute, dph_total adds default 10GB storage; bandwidth remains extra. gpu_frac describes host share, NOT fractional physical GPU.
Any null count, CPU/RAM, billing increment or minimum is unverified, not unlimited/free.
This is GPU-product research, not a claim that every feature of the entire vendor documentation was audited. Unverified features are null.
GPU multi-count bundles, variant/region selection and fractional slices require a SKU-aware estimator; unsupported rows remain unpriced in strict cards.

Modes with gpu=null are intentionally excluded, not free GPU modes. Never substitute 0 for a null rate. Flags alt indicate DIY/ML infrastructure, not the same thing as managed untrusted-code sandboxes.
Unknown fee, storage or bandwidth means full monthly total may be unavailable. Rates exclude taxes.

2026-09-28 fix pass: snapshot regimes collapsed to one per GPU (cheapest live verified offer, flag stock). Disk priced at $0.2667/GB-month = median host storage_cost across 71 live verified 1-GPU offers (range $0.08-$1.00/GB-month; the host you rent sets it; storage keeps billing while stopped). Egress $0.0052/GB = median host inet_up_cost across the same offers (host-specific; download also billed per host). Live prices moved since the earlier snapshot (e.g. H100 SXM $1.87 -> $3.09/h, H200 $3.55 -> $4.80/h).

fleet.verification: Verify email and prepay credits before renting.
fleet.notes: New accounts have a spend-rate limit, especially low before email verification; it grows over time. Docs suggest cheaper instance or waiting hours, then support chat if needed. No numeric default instance/GPU cap or guaranteed quota-raise time published.
